title: Chats
notConnectedHint: Connect to Harmony Link or cloud to load your entities.
noConversationsHint: Sync with Harmony Link to load your entities
aboutMessage:
Select an AI Entity from the list below to start chatting with. Each entity represents a unique AI personality you can interact with.

Use the 'Chatting as' banner at the top to choose which persona you want to use. This determines how each AI entity relates to you — for example, you could chat as yourself, or adopt a fictional character.

AI Entities learn individual relationships during interaction and may behave very differently depending on the Persona you are using.
preparingCloudHint: Your session is being provisioned. This usually takes a moment.
pickerHint: Pick one of your AI characters to chat with
pickerEmptyHint: Create an AI character first, then come back here.
pickerAllChattedHint: Every character already has a chat with this persona. Delete a conversation to offer it again.
archiveSectionHint: Long-press a chat to archive it. Archived chats are hidden from the main list.
archivedEmptyHint: Archive a conversation to keep it out of the way.
deleteConversationBody: Delete your chat history with {{name}}? Only this persona's conversation is removed — {{name}} is not deleted and will not forget you. To delete the complete entity, open the chat and use the entity menu → Delete entity.
disableConversationBody: Disable {{name}}? You will no longer send or receive messages with this AI. You can enable it anytime.
bubblePermissionBody: Allow Harmony AI Chat to display over other apps so the chat bubble can float above them.
bubblePermissionDenied: Overlay permission is required to show the chat bubble.
